208  THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

Reminiscences of Old Days:
    Judge J. Benton Maxey, Atoka, Oklahoma.
    Judge Lee A. Clark, Greenville, Texas.
    Mr. Jno. M. Gist, Odessa, Texas.
    Judge W. E. McMahon, Mexico City, D. F.
    Judge N. E. Peak, Greenville, Texas.
    Mr. Jim J. Gallagher, Waco, Texas.
    And others.

Solo, (a) Silver Threads Among the Gold.
     (b) When You and I Were Young, Maggie.
                    Miss Mary Alice Pritchett, Bonham, Texas.

Reading, L. J. (Lew) Reynolds, Arlington.

Song, "Savoy College Days," Lena Pace Hodges, Author, Hollywood, California.


LEVEE

    Following the Banquet an old time Levee will be held under the direction of Harry and Robert Naylor, Collinsville, assisted by Barlow Roberts, Sherman, and Doke Halsell, Durant, Oklahoma. Details announced at conclusion of banquet.


DEDICATION CEREMONY

August 7, 1938—2:00 P.M.
(Chairman of the Day, W. P. Carter,
    President Savoy School Board)

Music, Woodmen Circle Band, Sherman, Roy Hester, Director.

Invocation, Dr. William Deatherage, Dallas.

Address of Welcome, Hon. J. B. May, Mayor of Savoy.

Response, Hon. Mark McMahon, Fort Worth.

Recognition of the Descendants of Founders.

Song, Miss Mary Cornelia Roberts, Savoy.

Address, Hon. Sam Rayburn, M. C.

Music, Woodmen Circle Band, Sherman.

Address and Dedication, Gus W. Thomasson, Administrative Field Officer, Works Progress Administration, Dallas areas.
